resumen: GTA 6: rampage con tanque y 6 estrellas.

clips.titulo: GTA 6: You can NEVER lose 6 stars 🚨⭐
clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6 a 6-star wanted level is permanent: the game tells you the cops won't stop until you're hunted down.

Gameplay: ExoGhost (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you survive a permanent 6-star wanted level? 🚨
clips.motivo: Wanted-level mechanic shown by an official on-screen notice, twice; strong crime hook.

narracion.texto: Did you know in GTA 6 you can *NEVER* lose 6 stars?
Watch the *top corner*.
'You can't lose a *6-star* wanted level.' The cops *won't* give up.
Until you're *hunted down*. No hiding, no escape.
Minutes later, on a *different* stretch of beach...
The *same warning* pops right back up.
Those stars are *permanent*. It's a fight to the death.

clips.titulo: GTA 6: Max wanted level sends a TANK 💥🪖
clips.descripcion:
At max wanted level in GTA 6 the military joins the chase with armored vehicles and even a tank.

Gameplay: ExoGhost (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you fight the tank or run? 💥
clips.motivo: Tank arrival plus WASTED ending is a clean payoff for a wanted-level audience.

narracion.texto: Did you know in GTA 6, max wanted brings the *army*?
Military *armored cars* chase you across the beach.
There, an *eight-wheeled APC* closing in.
They keep pounding him with *heavy fire*.
No way out of *this one*.
His car's on fire, and here comes a *TANK*.

clips.descripcion:
Push your wanted level to 6 stars in GTA 6 and military helicopters join the hunt over the beach.

Gameplay: ExoGhost (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Tank vs attack chopper, who wins? 🚁
clips.motivo: Helicopters are clearly visible but small in frame; ending explosion is a nice payoff.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 sends *attack choppers* at 6 stars?
Look up. There it is, *circling* the beach.
A *military helicopter* swooping in low on his armored car.
It keeps *hammering* him from above.
And the chaos does *not* stop.
*Explosions* all over the sand.
Another *chopper* hunting him over the beach.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 cops send ARMORED Humvees with gunners 🚓💣
clips.descripcion:
High wanted levels in GTA 6 bring armored Humvees with a gunner on the roof turret.

Gameplay: ExoGhost (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.motivo: Turret gunner Humvee is visible and fits the police-escalation niche, but vehicles are small.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 cops roll *armored Humvees*?
Right there, a Humvee with a *gunner* on top.
And everything around him just *explodes*.
This is what *six stars* looks like.
Even off the sand, they *keep coming*.
They never *stop* chasing you.
Black Humvee, *turret gunner* locked on him.
